name: 育児短時間勤務の請求を書面以外でも可能に
summary: 現在、育児短時間勤務の承認や期間延長の請求は、書面で行う規定です。この議案では、規則で定める方法により、書面以外でも請求できるようにします。
changes: 請求方法を、書面から規則で定める方法に改める
who: 育児短時間勤務の承認や期間延長を請求する区職員
why: 育児短時間勤務の承認や期間延長の請求を、書面以外の方法でも行えるようにするためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Allows requests for childcare short-time work by methods other than in writing
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Childcare Leave, etc. for Employees
en.summary: Currently, requests for approval of childcare short-time work or an extension of its period must be made in writing. This bill allows requests to be made by methods specified in rules, including methods other than in writing.
changes: Changes the request method from writing to methods specified in rules
who: Ward employees requesting approval for childcare short-time work or an extension of its period
en.why: The mayor says this is to allow requests for approval of childcare short-time work or an extension of its period to be made by methods other than in writing.
